---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_trim(Country) |> str_to_lower(),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attack_counts <- attacks |>
  filter(!is.na(Country_lower)) |>
  count(Country_lower, name = "attacks")

world_map <- map_data("world") |>
  mutate(Country_lower = str_trim(str_to_lower(region))) |>
  left_join(attack_counts, by = "Country_lower") |>
  replace_na(list(attacks = 0))

ggplot(world_map, aes(long, lat, group = group, fill = attacks)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Shark attacks",
    trans = "sqrt",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  coord_fixed(1.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Shark Attacks by Country",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  filter(Fatal %in% c("Y", "N")) |>
  count(Fatal) |>
  mutate(
    outcome = if_else(Fatal == "Y", "Fatal", "Non-fatal")
  ) |>
  select(outcome, count = n)
```
